# tests/fixtures/odt — OpenDocument text fixtures (feature 003)

Generated by `../builders/odt.py` (`build_odt`, run by `../build_fixtures.py`) with the standard library, as ODF 1.3 says: `mimetype` first
and stored, `META-INF/manifest.xml`, `content.xml`, `styles.xml`, pictures and formula objects. Rebuilding gives
the same bytes (a test checks it). `real/` holds files written by LibreOffice itself.

| File | What it is for |
|---|---|
| `report.odt` | the whole text subset: title, subtitle, headings, every emphasis, lists, links, notes, quotes, code, spaces, fields, hidden and generated content, a table |
| `no_extension_odt` | the same report without extension (magika `odt`) |
| `merged.odt` | a table with merged cells |
| `revisions.odt` | a comment and a tracked deletion |
| `unknown.odt` | elements outside the subset (a custom shape, ruby text) |
| `images.odt` | images with a title, a description, only a name |
| `formulas.odt` | formulas inside the MathML subset, one outside, one pointing outside the archive |
| `spreadsheet.odt` | an OpenDocument spreadsheet renamed to `.odt` |
| `encrypted.odt` | `content.xml` declared encrypted in the manifest |
| `damaged.odt` | half of `report.odt` |
| `hostile/` | a `DOCTYPE`, ten levels of nested entities, 20,000 nested spans, 300,000 paragraphs, an object outside the archive, a zip bomb |
| `real/` | `report.odt` saved by LibreOffice 7.4 from `report.fodt` (`make_real.sh`) |
